stacking.note: Up to 4 members in a Virtual Chassis over the QSFP28 ports, which otherwise serve as uplinks

routing.summary: Junos Layer 3: static, OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, PIM, VRF, and BGP EVPN-VXLAN. Advanced routing needs a Flex license

macsec: MACsec AES-256 supported; port scope not captured from datasheet

power.summary: Two field-replaceable, hot-swap AC or DC power supplies with front-to-back or back-to-front airflow

redundancy.detail: Two PSU slots, load sharing; airflow matched across PSUs and fans

licensing: Juniper Flex: base features included; advanced routing (OSPF, BGP, EVPN-VXLAN) needs a Flex Advanced or Premium license. Mist Wired Assurance with subscription
verifyNote: Juniper datasheet states 4 Tbps / 2.98 Bpps; some third-party listings cite 2 Tbps / 1.49 Bpps (likely unidirectional). Using the vendor figure. Route scale, MAC table, MACsec scope, and buffer need confirming from the EX4650 datasheet

models.note: Sold as -48Y-AFI (back-to-front) and -48Y-AFO (front-to-back). Each QSFP28 can break out to 4x 25G, for up to 80 total 25G ports
